item.title: CATA ceases service for winter weather
item.description: STATE COLLEGE, PA. (WTAJ) — CATA has suspended all services, including CATABUS and CATARIDE, for Sunday, Jan. 26. "We recognize that this may cause inconvenience for some riders, and this decision was not made lightly." Adam Simpson, CATA's PR Specialist, said. "However, the safety and well-being of our passengers and employees remain our highest priority." [...]

item.title: Changes may be coming to Pennsylvania hunting seasons
item.description: PENNSYLVANIA (WTAJ) — The Pennsylvania Board of Game Commissioners has preliminarily approved the 2026-27 hunting and trapping seasons and bag limits. The proposal is open to public comment between now and the board’s April meeting, when 2026-27 seasons and bag limits will be finalized. item.title: Clearfield County government to close Monday
item.description: CLEARFIELD, Pa. (WTAJ) — The Clearfield County government will be closed Monday, Jan. 26, due to severe winter weather conditions. The closure includes the courthouse and all government offices, and only essential personnel will report to work as usual. item.title: Altoona duo accused of selling heroin in man's overdose death
item.description: ALTOONA, Pa. (WTAJ) — Charges were filed against two people for their roles in the overdose death of an Altoona man. Stefanie Lestochi, 45, and Martin Lear Jr., 45, are both facing felony and misdemeanor conspiracy charges, including drug delivery resulting in death, possession with intent to manufacture or deliver, and recklessly endangering another person.
